modules.title: 同一种商品卡怎样在不同页面共用

items.title: 把重复责任放在一起
items.text: 卡片的结构、样式和点击后的行为可以一起维护；价格格式或按钮文案改变时，不必在三个页面分别修改。

items.title: 组合后才成为完整页面
items.text: 导航、商品卡、筛选区等组件由页面按当前场景排列；同一组件可接收不同商品数据，却保持一致的交互和外观。

items.title: 用参数控制组件显示什么
items.text: 组件可以接收外部传入的参数（在 React 中叫 Props）来控制显示内容。例如，商品卡片组件从外部接收商品名称、价格和图片。当你告诉 AI “让这个组件接收一个 title 参数”时，你描述的就是 Props。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 组件不是框架专属概念，也不是整张页面的同义词。React、Vue 或原生网页都可以有组件；只有一次出现、没有独立责任的简单文字，不必为了复用而强行拆分。

lessonPractice.title: 三个页面都要显示同一种“活动卡片”，以后还会一起修改。怎样组织才能统一维护？

options.label: 做成一个可复用的活动卡片，由各页面传入内容
options.feedback: 对。卡片的共同责任集中在一起，改卡片样式或行为后，三个页面会得到同一套结果。

options.label: 在三个页面各复制一份卡片，再用全局 CSS 保持外观一致
options.feedback: 复制可以暂时显示内容，但共同规则会分散，后续容易漏改或出现不一致。

options.label: 做成一个高度可配置的通用卡片，把三个页面的差异都变成参数
options.feedback: 参数越多不代表复用越好。组件应集中稳定的共同责任；把所有差异都塞成开关，会让调用和维护同样复杂。

en.title: The event page, homepage, and search page all need cards with the same rules. Which approach makes later changes consistent?

options.label: Put the image, title, state, and click behavior in one event-card component, with each page passing its own data
options.feedback: Correct. The card's shared responsibility lives in one place, so a style or behavior change reaches all three pages.

options.label: Copy the card code into every page, then edit titles and buttons separately
options.feedback: It can show content initially, but shared rules become scattered and will drift or be missed later.

options.label: Put every page and feature into one component named Website
options.feedback: That does not separate responsibilities. A component should make one reasonably independent part of the interface easier to understand and maintain.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把重复出现的活动卡整理成组件。首页、活动页和搜索结果都使用它，但保留各自传入的图片、标题和状态。改完后检查三个页面的卡片外观和点击行为一致。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Turn the repeated event card into a component. Use it on the home, event, and search pages while keeping each page's image, title, and state as inputs. Afterward, check that the card looks and behaves consistently on all three pages.

learning.assumes: You have seen the same kind of card or button appear in several places on one site.
learning.outcome: You can identify an interface area that should change together and distinguish it from a whole-page layout or one-off content.

modules.title: How one product card is shared across pages

items.title: Keep repeated responsibility together
items.text: A card's structure, styles, and click behavior can be maintained together, so a price format or button-label change does not require edits on three pages.

items.title: Pages compose components
items.text: A page arranges navigation, cards, and filters for its current task. The same component can receive different product data while retaining consistent interaction and appearance.

items.title: Control what components display with parameters
items.text: Components accept parameters (called Props in React) to control what they display. For example, a product card component receives product name, price, and image from the outside. When you tell AI "make this component accept a title parameter", you're describing Props.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A component is not exclusive to a framework, nor is it another word for a whole page. React, Vue, and plain web pages can all use components. One-off plain text with no independent responsibility does not need forced extraction.

distinctions.label: State
distinctions.text: A {c:component} defines one piece of UI structure and responsibility. {c:state} records changing information such as whether that component is open or saving.
